target.assumptions: Retail about 3x BOM; includes enclosure, assembly, FCC/CE amortisation, shipping and margin. FM-1 street price is about $70, so this is 2-3x the FM-1. Market comparison: Chompi $599, EP-133 about GBP 275.

summary: A small groovebox, $150-250 retail. Prototype on a Daisy Seed (64 MB SDRAM, stereo codec, SD, 480 MHz M7) running core/ SFA ONE; product path is a custom STM32H750 board reusing the simulator and engine.

sections.title: Screen
sections.summary: Small colour LCD, reusing the FM-1 UI work.

items.label: Panel
items.value: 1.54in 240x240 IPS, ST7789, SPI
items.note: Same controller and resolution as the FM-1, so the UI code ports as is

items.label: Refresh
items.value: SPI at 40-60 MHz with DMA, dirty-rect redraw

items.label: Upgrade
items.value: 2.0in 320x240 later
items.note: Only if the UI needs it

sections.title: Controls
sections.summary: Pads, four encoders, a few buttons.

items.label: Pads
items.value: 16 velocity-sensing pads (FSR matrix or silicone over FSR)
items.note: FM-1 has no velocity pads; an FSR matrix is a known DIY pattern (PJRC Teensy project)

items.label: Encoders
items.value: 4 push encoders (the four SFA macros TONE BODY COLOR MOTION)

items.label: Buttons
items.value: 12 tactile: play, rec, shift, page, track, undo...

items.label: Alternative
items.value: MPR121 touch pads (no velocity) as in Rheslip Pico-2 Groovebox

sections.title: Audio I/O
sections.summary: Stereo out, stereo line in, headphones.

items.label: Codec
items.value: Daisy Seed onboard stereo 24-bit up to 96 kHz (prototype); TLV320AIC3204 on the product board
items.note: TLV320: 100 dB DAC SNR, 93 dB ADC SNR (LCSC listing)

items.label: Out
items.value: 2x 3.5mm (or 6.35mm) line out + headphone

items.label: In
items.value: stereo line in, mic via preamp later
items.note: Sampling from line is the main use

items.label: USB
items.value: USB-C: power, MIDI, mass storage; USB audio class unverified on Daisy

sections.title: MIDI
sections.summary: TRS-A in and out plus USB MIDI.

items.label: TRS MIDI in
items.value: Type A, 6N138 optocoupler
items.note: FM-1 is MIDI in only on TRS (base commit message)

items.label: TRS MIDI out/thru
items.value: Switchable out or thru

items.label: USB MIDI
items.value: Device mode; host mode optional

sections.title: Engines
sections.summary: SFA ONE first, then ECB and Alien Stack voices ported.

items.label: Engine
items.value: core/ SFA ONE: exciter, resonator, folder, ladder, 4 voices
items.note: Plain C99 float, no allocation: ports directly

items.label: CPU
items.value: Four voices cost about twice ECB's whole render on host
items.note: Sizes the processor; 480 MHz M7 with FPU has headroom over the FM-1's pi32v2 at 360 MHz

items.label: Target
items.value: 8-16 voices at 48 kHz, no xruns

sections.title: Sampler
sections.summary: Play, chop, resample; samples live in RAM and on SD.

items.label: RAM
items.value: 64 MB SDRAM on Daisy
items.note: FM-1 store is 184 KB, about 4.2 s of 22.05 kHz mono; 64 MB is minutes at 48 kHz stereo

items.label: Format
items.value: 48 kHz 16/24-bit WAV from SD

items.label: Features
items.value: auto-chop, per-pad pitch, reverse, loop, resample the mix

sections.title: Sequencer
sections.summary: Step sequencer with 16 steps per pad, parameter locks and song chain.

items.label: Resolution
items.value: 96 PPQN internal, MIDI clock in/out

items.label: Patterns
items.value: 64 patterns, 16 tracks

items.label: Reuse
items.value: ECB step entry and GEN/BEAT generators

sections.title: Storage
sections.summary: microSD for samples, projects and firmware images.

items.label: Card
items.value: microSD via SDMMC (Daisy has an SD interface)
items.note: Rheslip Pico-2 Groovebox also uses microSD

items.label: Internal
items.value: QSPI flash for firmware; H750 has only 128 KB internal flash

items.label: Backup
items.value: Projects as plain files, drag from computer

sections.title: Power
sections.summary: USB-C or one LiPo cell; charge and play.

items.label: Battery
items.value: single-cell LiPo about 2000 mAh

items.label: Charger
items.value: USB-C charge IC (bq25185 class)

items.label: Shipping
items.value: UN 38.3 test summary and labels needed to ship cells by air

items.label: Prototype
items.value: FDM or resin print, laser-cut top plate

items.label: Size
items.value: about Chompi size, roughly 180x120x30 mm
items.note: Chompi page gave price, not size

items.label: Product
items.value: aluminium extrusion or injection ABS; tooling is a large fixed cost

sections.title: Software
sections.summary: One portable core, many targets, simulator first.

items.label: Layering
items.value: core/ engines + plat.h-style HAL (68 functions on FM-1) + host simulator

items.label: Loop
items.value: tools/sfa sim -> render -> report before any flash

items.label: Licence
items.value: SFA code own; fm1-base MPL-2.0; check Daisy hardware reuse licence
